Since New Updates the game has been a must play in VR and flat Screen i even play it through steam link on my phone and ipad

Love it 
Devs Keep up  the GREAT WORK!!!!!
The new update I played for the first time to night was prof the devs have doing there jobs!!!!(2025)

overall, not great. from the get go, little to no vr customization options, and toggle grab being the standard. who uses toggle grab, honestly? the functions are based on the force sensor, so i littler have to crush my controller to drop items. lack of this customization makes it impossible to play at all. 

that aside, scaling is terrible with guns vs the size of your hand, putting kit together, anything that requires dexterity, not a whole lot of highlighting or sweet spots, just feels extremely janky, like a cheap chinese knockoff overall.
